description.value: Veneto's Cakes & Pastries is a Surrey bakery specializing in handcrafted cakes, pastries, cookies, and sandwiches made fresh daily. The shop is known locally for custom birthday and wedding cakes, and also offers eggless and gluten-free options alongside classics like Black Forest, Tiramisu, and Hazelnut Torte. Cyclists passing through can pick up individual pastries or sandwiches in-store, or order ahead for pickup.

address.value: 7380 King George Blvd Unit 506, Surrey, BC V3W 5A5, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at venetoscakes.com is active and confirms a real, operating bakery offering cakes, pastries, cookies, and sandwiches for pickup or delivery in Surrey, BC. The phone number shown on the website (604 597 9886) matches the OSM-linked contact, confirming the business identity. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; the OSM tags also contain no relevant amenity keys.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Tsawwassen' but website consistently locates the business in Surrey, BC; these are distinct municipalities and the OSM pin or community tag may be misplaced.
No physical street address is present in OSM tags or on the business website, making the exact location unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active bakery with a functioning website, online ordering, and confirmed contact details — a useful food stop for touring cyclists.
